title: HitPings
description: HitPing plays audio feedback when you land 3 block hits. A soft ping sounds on hits between 2.8–2.9 blocks, and a sharper ping sounds on hits at 2.9+ blocks helping you recognize 3 blocks and improve your spacing.
body: This is a **purly audio** mod that plays a ping sound when you land spaced hits in PVP. A soft ping sounds on hits between 2.8–2.9 blocks, and a sharper ping sounds on hits at 2.9+ blocks everything is configurable to your liking including the distance of hit which the sound will play, the volume and type of the sounds helping you recognize 3 block hits and improve your spacing.
